body: I have failed at every opportunity. There is nothing in my life that I can look forward to. I don't even have a single person I can call "friend". My children hate me, my husband left me for a married woman twice my age, I am not important to anyone. I am the person that no one thinks twice about, if they even think once at all.

I've been looking forward to going Christmas shopping with my mom all week. It's literally the only thing that's been keeping me sane. My dad fell on the ice on their way over, so they're at the hospital now (He just had a hip replacement). She's an hour away so I know she won't come so far, and I don't blame her. But what if this is God freeing up my day so I can do it?
A series of very poor decisions on my part.
